mapper.select: select amount from t_user_coin where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update t_user_coin set amount = #{amount}, update_time = #{updateTime} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: update t_user_coin set amount = amount + #{amount}, update_time = #{updateTime} where user_id = #{userId}
insert into t_user_coin (user_id, amount, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
